scope: Layout only: per-record audit blocks moved to peritheos/data/audits; a check headline added; identifier-derived report links omitted from sidecars and regenerated on load; the generic statements listed here removed. Coefficients, errors, covariance, datasets, sources and scientific classifications are unchanged.
layout_revision: 2026-11-16: bindings regenerated from the unchanged pre-split files for the v5 check-block and reading-order revision. check fields renamed (finding -> source_note, source -> source_check) and compared/why added; per-record default flags moved to the material default_records map (default_flags/added_default_records restore them); record files use the v5 reading order. layout 'v4' names pre-split files rendered with the v4 key order. Sidecars and before_sha256 values are unchanged.

evidence.reproduction.assessment.qualifi: This named numerical assessment alone does not establish author-workflow reproduction, physical accuracy or recommendation for use.
No reconstructed coefficient table is recorded for this assessment; no missing values have been inferred.
evidence.scientific_validation.note: Independently checked against the cited primary publication (published article or official/author copy); no external software catalog was used as scientific authority.

check_text.usage_recommendation: NOT REPRODUCED: the published fit could not be independently reproduced from the available evidence. Digitized-data refits are diagnostic only; broad error-bar overlap does not establish reproduction. Historical hcp compression only; prefer the separate Dewaele (2021) fcc thermal EOS for fcc argon. Do not extrapolate this BM2 fit beyond 8.5 GPa as a pressure standard.

record_text_revision: Free-text revisions after the split (label, notes, validity.notes, thermal.notes) keep every replaced original verbatim in the record's superseded_record_text sidecar block. A binding's superseded_record_text lists those record indices; recovery restores the originals and removes the block first. after_record_sha256 and after_audit_sha256 bind the revised files; before_sha256 values are unchanged.
check_text_revision: Curated check texts written after the split (scientific_validation.primary_source_check.record_note and scientific_validation.warning_reason, copied into check.source_note and check.warning_reason) and coded usage recommendations (scientific_validation.usage_recommendation, the source of check.warning, with the recommendation_reason and assessment qualifications derived from it, field assessment_qualifications) are bound as check_text entries [index, {field: original}], original null meaning absent; recovery restores them before removing the check blocks. finding is never changed. after_record_sha256 and after_audit_sha256 bind the revised files; before_sha256 values are unchanged.
catalog_revision: A binding's catalog_revision_sha256 is the sha256 of the pre-split reference after the material's latest revision in docs/data/catalog-revisions.json; restoring the current files with the binding gives that reference, and reversing the material's revisions recovers before_sha256, which is unchanged.
material_text_revision: A material's top-level notes revised after the split keep the replaced original verbatim in the sidecar's top-level superseded_material_text block; its binding then holds superseded_material_text: true, and recovery restores the notes and removes the block first.
generated_check_refresh: Generated check fields refreshed after a change of their wording (scripts/apply_check_text.py --refresh-why): each record's check block is rederived from its unchanged evidence and only check.why may change. Recovery removes every check block, so only after_record_sha256 is rebound; sidecars and before_sha256 values are unchanged.
